name: noctulist-firebase-tests
description: Security-rules tests, portal function tests and local preview for the NoctuList public pages (Firebase emulators only).

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions && npm run test:site
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix ../../webform/functions run build && ./emulators.sh emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 functions/*.test.mjs"
